name: Sakurazuka Kaoru
source:
A normal Japanese youth who has never had much to do with girls and is sure he'll die a virgin. He has a complex about his effeminate features and his unisex name. He tries to make up for looking like a girl by wearing an extra coating of male bravado wherever he goes. When he's changed into a girl after drinking a strange potion, he learns that his body possesses rare "yin-yang" (dual-sex) DNA.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yin-Yang!_X-Change_Alternative]Wikipedia[/url] and game manual]
